name: pages_for_site
title: Pages (name, type, status, url)
sql: SELECT name, page_type, status, url FROM pages WHERE site_id = $1 ORDER BY name

name: page_components_for_page
title: Page components for a page (position, slot, build_status, function)
sql: SELECT pc.position, pc.slot_name, pc.build_status, pc.created_at, pc.updated_at, cc.function, cc.section_type FROM page_components pc JOIN content_components cc ON cc.id = pc.component_id JOIN pages p ON p.id = pc.page_id WHERE p.site_id = $1 AND p.name = $2 ORDER BY pc.position

name: work_items_recent
title: Recent work items (type, status, attempts, error)
sql: SELECT item_type, status, attempts, error, item_key, created_at, completed_at FROM site_work_items WHERE site_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30

name: needs_page_items
title: needs_page work items with page_name (did the build run per page?)
sql: SELECT item_type, status, error, item_key, created_at, completed_at, spec->>'page_name' AS page_name FROM site_work_items WHERE site_id = $1 AND item_type = 'needs_page' ORDER BY created_at DESC

name: site_specs_current
title: Current site specs (aspect, source)
sql: SELECT aspect, source, source_agent, is_current, created_at FROM site_specs WHERE site_id = $1 AND is_current ORDER BY aspect
